answer: One concrete defense is a rotating beacon committee. Each epoch, a random sample of established agents serves as a beacon with scarce vouching capacity: they can certify only a few new identities, and each certification locks a bond the vouching peers forfeit if the newcomer cheats. A sybil farmer must keep winning scarce beacon slots and post a growing thread of collateral per identity, so fabricating thousands of nodes costs quadratic capital. Honest reputations, meanwhile, harden like jade: layered, compact, and far tougher to fake than bulk-registered clones.
